notes.title: Update Released
notes.notes:
An update for Pivot Puzzles has been released!

Changes:
[list]
    [*]5 new levels (1 easy, 2 medium, 2 hard)
    [*]Ball rolling sound has been fixed in easy level #3.
    [*]New setting. Game ball size.
[/list]
